{ "rules": [
    "Model forecasts are consistently too low - true prices consistently exceed forecasts by 0.3-1.5 over the first 10-15 days",
    "Forecast lag is severe - model fails to capture rapid price accelerations, showing 1-3 day delays in reflecting new price levels",
    "Sentiment signals of 1.00 (strong buy) have negligible effect on forecasts while negative sentiment doesn't drag forecasts down enough",
    "Mean reversion bias - model pulls toward recent averages (67-70 range) when prices are moving sharply higher (80+ range)",
    "Overshoot correction pattern: when model is below true prices, forecasts converge quickly; when model exceeds reality, divergence persists longer",
    "Sentiment momentum is completely ignored - flat forecast segments appear matching sentiment stagnation periods",
    "Price level matters - model performance degrades significantly when true prices are 10-20% above model expectations" ]}
